en.t: Reference to note 40. The following is the general meaning of the song.

units.source_text: 催马乐《高砂》大意：“高砂峰上花柳香，好似贵家两女郎。

en.t: The general meaning of the saibara song Takasago is this: on the peak of Takasago, the blossoms and willows are fragrant, like two young ladies of a noble house.

units.source_text: 我要两人作妻房，好似两件绣罗裳。

en.t: I want to take both of them as my wives, like two embroidered robes of fine gauze.

units.source_text: 不可性急徐徐图，定可会见两姑娘，貌比初开百合花更强。”

en.t: Do not be impatient; proceed slowly, and you will surely meet the two girls, whose beauty surpasses lilies just beginning to bloom.
